plan_b_advantages: Includes speed work for pace improvement
More frequent rest days for recovery
Strength training focused on trail-specific demands
reasoning: Plan B is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates more structured speed work (tempo and intervals) which directly addresses the goal of increasing running speed, unlike Plan A's focus primarily on building aerobic endurance. While Plan A is a solid foundation, it lacks the intensity needed to truly improve pace. Plan B also includes more frequent rest days, crucial for recovery and preventing overtraining, especially when incorporating harder sessions. Furthermore, the inclusion of strength training focused on incline work is a valuable addition for trail running.
